name: Summer 2027 - The Last Frontier
summary: A road-and-fly trip through interior and Arctic Alaska — Denali, Gates of the Arctic, Wrangell–St. Elias, and Kobuk Valley — followed by a week cruising Hubbard Glacier, Glacier Bay, and the Inside Passage. Five days in the middle are still open for Lake Clark and Katmai.
